title: WPGSI: Spreadsheet Integration before 3.8.5 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability that allows…
description: WPGSI: Spreadsheet Integration versions before 3.8.5 have a cross-site request forgery (CSRF) vulnerability. This flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to delete posts by exploiting the delete action in the wpgsi_show_view() function without nonce verification. Attackers can trick logged-in administrators into clicking a crafted link that triggers deletion of arbitrary posts or pages.
